_read_me: The setup kit's settings for this game, each at its default. A game ships this file beside its program and may change any value (its own report_url and catalogs above all). Layers, each over the one before: this file; the values the game's signed catalog gives (setup_kit, for every game and for this one, and the game's report page), fetched at most every live_every_hours; then a copy of this file in the game's data folder, for a player's own changes. Out of range: the nearest end is used; anything else wrong: the value before it. The game's log says which. Signing keys and checks are never set here.
_hint_starts: 0 to 20, starts: the first starts that show the SETUP hint in the corner (0: never)
_hint_seconds: 3 to 60, seconds: how long the hint stays
_hint_fade_out_seconds: 0 to 3, seconds: its fade out (also after its x)
_update_notice_seconds: 3 to 60, seconds: how long UPDATE AVAILABLE stays in the corner when the start-up check finds a new version (the hint's fades)
_check_listed: 1 to 50, files: CHECK MY FILES names this many damaged files, then counts the rest
_report_url: an https:// address: REPORT A PROBLEM's page (empty: the game's own; the catalog's report page comes before this)
_catalogs: up to 5 https:// addresses: where the signed games catalog is asked, in order (empty: the game's own)
_live_every_hours: 1 to 168, hours: the catalog asked again for these values at most this often
_update_check_hours: 12 to 720, hours: the start-up update check at most this often
_catalog_seconds: 5 to 120, seconds: time allowed for the catalog, and again for its signature
_releases_seconds: 5 to 120, seconds: time allowed for a game's releases list
_releases_count: 10 to 40, releases: releases asked for in that list
_sums_seconds: 10 to 300, seconds: time allowed for an update's SHA256SUMS, and again for its signature
_count_seconds: 3 to 60, seconds: time allowed for the update count
_download_connect_seconds: 5 to 120, seconds: a download gives up when it cannot connect in this long
_download_slow_bytes_per_second: 1 to 65536, bytes a second: a download slower than this...
_download_slow_seconds: 15 to 600, seconds: ...for this long is given up
